heading: Okanagan Winery Restaurants for Fall
title: Okanagan Winery Restaurants for Fall | Okanagan Roam
description: Heated patios, tasting menus, wood-fired pizza and lake views: Okanagan winery restaurants for an unhurried fall meal, from Lake Country to Osoyoos.
intro: After harvest, the pace in wine country slows down, and a long meal at a winery is an easy way to spend a fall day. This guide picks winery restaurants worth lingering at, from covered and heated patios to tasting menus and casual plates on the lawn.
Many winery kitchens change their hours and service as the season winds down, so check the listing or book ahead before you set out.

items.name: Serendipity Winery
items.text: A tiny, one-chef bistro and winery with a covered, heated patio, so weather rarely gets in the way. Booking ahead is essential.

items.name: Summerhill Pyramid Winery
items.text: A certified-organic estate built around a pyramid, with a heated lake-view terrace and its own on-site restaurant.

items.name: CedarCreek Estate Winery
items.text: A lake view and cozy outdoor booths. Regulars recommend the schnitzel with a glass of the estate's own Pinot Gris.

items.name: Lookout Restaurant
items.text: The fine-dining patio at Gray Monk Winery, high above Okanagan Lake, with scallops with pork belly anchoring the menu.

items.name: Chaos Bistro
items.text: The restaurant at Ex Nihilo Vineyards, with a chef happy to accommodate vegan guests, warm service, and a Canadian mushroom pizza reviewers call among the best they've had.

items.name: Row 188 @ O'Rourke Family Estate
items.text: Upscale wine-paired tasting menus that reviewers call some of the best dining in the Okanagan. One to plan a special occasion around.

items.name: Terrace Restaurant
items.text: Mission Hill's upscale multi-course dining room, with wine-paired tasting menus, a complimentary welcome glass of wine and views over vineyards and Okanagan Lake.

items.name: Old Vines Restaurant
items.text: Quails' Gate's fine dining room, with lake and mountain views, haskap-cured salmon and 63 Acres beef tenderloin, and staff who are patient with young families.

items.name: Tula Restaurant @ Little Straw Vineyards
items.text: Indian-fusion cooking with real vegan dishes and patio seating over the vines.

items.name: The Modest Butcher Kitchen + Market
items.text: A steakhouse at Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery with a Tomahawk steak specialty and patience for toddlers at the table.

items.name: 19 Bistro @ Fitz
items.text: At Fitzpatrick Family Vineyards above Peachland. The fish taco is the dish regulars mention first. Dog with you? No problem, and no reservation needed.

items.name: Bench 1775 Winery
items.text: Bistro and winery in one, serving dim sum alongside the wine list. The patio looks out over the Naramata Bench, vines rolling toward the lake.

items.name: Lake Breeze Vineyards Tasting Room
items.text: A shaded tasting-room restaurant overlooking the vines. Reviewers recommend the mussels and the whipped feta.

items.name: Hillside Winery
items.text: Award-winning wines and an on-site bistro that has warmly accommodated dinner with kids in tow.

items.name: The Restaurant at Poplar Grove
items.text: Fine dining with a stunning lake view, gluten-free bread, and a team that makes anniversaries and milestone birthdays feel special.

items.name: The Hot Dog Lounge at JoieFarm
items.text: Gourmet hot dogs on the winery lawn, so a tasting can turn into a relaxed lunch. Toppings run from a classic ballpark dog to Korean-inspired kimchi and an elote-style street dog, with JoieFarm wine by the glass or a cold beer. Come early for the 11 to 1 happy hour.

items.name: Kitchen @ Ve Oh Lay Acres Honey Wine & Farm
items.text: A dog-friendly taco kitchen at a honey winery and farm, with a shaded patio, non-alcoholic wine options and a family-friendly, laid-back feel.

items.name: The Restaurant at Liquidity Wines
items.text: Napa-level food with none of the attitude, and live music most Thursdays.

items.name: Vineyard Kitchen & Patio at Nighthawk Vineyards
items.text: A small family-run restaurant on Green Lake with an inspired, locally sourced menu.

items.name: Wild Goose Winery
items.text: A patio with mountain and vineyard views, and a newly rebranded bistro putting out standout seasonal dishes.

items.name: Terrafina at Hester Creek
items.text: A patio restaurant built around focaccia spreads and seasonal pasta.

items.name: Miradoro Restaurant
items.text: The restaurant at Tinhorn Creek Vineyards, with some of the best views in the South Okanagan, Neapolitan pizza and a black pepper carbonara with crispy smoked pork jowl. Well suited to larger groups.

items.name: Sonora Room Restaurant
items.text: A balcony restaurant at Burrowing Owl Estate Winery, with some of the best vineyard views in the South Okanagan.

items.name: Sweetgrass @ Nk'Mip Cellars
items.text: The restaurant at North America's first Indigenous-owned winery, with shareable plates like duck wings and bison meatballs and desert and lake views.
